purpose: Frozen copy/paste prompts and semantic expectations for checking whether a future agent follows the intended Grade9V3 routing path. These are system stress fixtures, never learner evidence.
rules: Owner knowledge percentage selects a conservative starting coordinate only; it is never mastery evidence.
CORE1A and CORE1B traverse the same canonical rung segment; agency changes, target/depth do not.
Practice support comes from purpose, not from learner percentage.
Missing source basis for source-backed practice must remain an explicit owner input; the agent must not invent source custody.
Prerequisites remain checks/bridges unless evidence demonstrates them.
The agent derives current matrix/library facts from the repository rather than relying on remembered content.
No fixture may create LIVE_LEARNER evidence.
